items.title: Schedule appointment with drying company
items.quote:
Bitte vereinbaren Sie binnen 5 Arbeitstagen ab Briefdatum einen Termin mit der Firma
Trocknungstechnik Beispiel (Telefon 0541 22 11 00); Arbeitstage sind Montag bis Freitag,
gesetzliche Feiertage ausgenommen.
items.computation: Start: Briefdatum (letter date) = Wed 20.05.2026. The letter sets a private contractual deadline counted 'ab Briefdatum' (from the letter date); per §§ 187, 188 BGB the day of the triggering event is not counted, so counting begins the next day. 'Arbeitstage' is explicitly defined in the letter as Monday to Friday, excluding statutory public holidays. Counting 5 Arbeitstage: Day 1 = Thu 21.05, Day 2 = Fri 22.05, (weekend Sat 23.05/Sun 24.05 skipped, not Arbeitstage), Day 3 = Mon 25.05, Day 4 = Tue 26.05, Day 5 = Wed 27.05. No public holidays fall in this window in NW (Ascension Day was 14.05.2026, before the period; Whit Monday is 01.06.2026, after it). Since the count is already in business days, the result (Wed 27.05.2026, a Wednesday) is automatically a business day, so no further weekend/holiday shift under § 193 BGB is needed.
